question.text: A carrier wave with amplitude of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>250</mn><mo> </mo><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">V</mi></math> is amplitude modulated by a sinusoidal base band signal of amplitude <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>150</mn><mo> </mo><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">V</mi><mo>.</mo></math> The ratio of minimum amplitude to maximum amplitude for the amplitude modulated wave is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>50</mn><mo>:</mo><mo> </mo><mi>x</mi><mo>,</mo></math> then value of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>x</mi><mo>,</mo></math> is <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>_</mi><mi>_</mi><mi>_</mi><mi>_</mi><mi>_</mi><mi>_</mi><mi>_</mi><mi>_</mi><mi>_</mi><mo>.</mo></math>

solution.text:
The value of maximum amplitude, Amax=Ac+Am=250+150 V=400 V
, and the value of minimum amplitude,Amin=Ac-Am=250-150 V=100 V
⇒AminAmax=100 V400 V=14=50200⇒x=200 V
